review_scope: Source question-body crop fidelity. Separate preparation and independent review inspected full source pages and all actual output parts. External answer scoring and neighboring questions excluded; original body notation and figures preserved.
limitations: Not answer recertification, original-source completeness, accessible transcription or redistribution authorization. Browser QA remains blocked.

independent_review.review_scope: Crop bounds and mapping fidelity to available visible third-party reproduction only.
findings: Independently inspected all ten complete source pages, then every part in 24 actual WebP-derived contact sheets. Complete available question bodies, options, diagrams, code, tables, prompt endings and continuations are retained without unrelated question leakage.

Canonical identifiers Q1-Q101 match the 101 stored records. Reproduction numbering 1-50 corresponds to stored 1.1-1.25 and 2.1-2.25; reproduction 51-70 and letter/roman subparts correspond to stored 3-22. Detailed mapping recorded below. No identifiers were painted onto source images.
Q15, Q25, Q27, Q31, Q36, Q41, Q46 and Q50 retain their split options or tables; Q56, Q63-Q64, Q67-Q68, Q73, Q79-Q81, Q85 and Q89-Q91 retain their cross-column or page continuations.
Q26 deliberately includes the decorative right border because its circuit output label extends across that border. The label is not clipped.

All 71 inter-question positive-area overlaps were independently recomputed and reviewed. They are exact shared-heading, stem, figure, code or required prerequisite rectangles. No nonidentical or unrelated overlaps occur. Explicit question/part approvals are below.

Freshly rendered every crop from the canonical source using 3x PyMuPDF and Pillow WebP quality 80; all 190 file bytes match the reviewed files and stored audit SHA256 values. Rebuilt contact sheets match the viewed PNG pixels, and all ten viewed source-page PNGs match fresh full-page 2x renders.
limitations: Low-quality third-party scanned reproduction with imperfect OCR and missing Fm0 XObject parser warnings on every page. Approval is not original-paper completeness, source correctness, official-answer verification, accessible transcription, or redistribution permission.
Q29 duplicate A/D choice is retained; Q27 enable convention and Q39 overlapping choices are not repaired.
Q62 (reproduced 55b) has an absent or illegible input-count numeral after each with. The crop includes the entire available prompt and circuit; no numeral is invented.
Q67-Q68 (reproduced 58) cache-capacity digit is degraded and resembles S in the available image. It is preserved, not interpreted as a certified numeral.
Q99-Q101 (reproduced 70) final grammar terminal appears di but is ambiguous. All available grammar lines remain intact without repair.
General section instructions and decorative page headers/footers are excluded, except the Q26 border needed to retain the diagram label.
